description_en: Queries the mapping between applications and tags
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources接口查询应用和标签的对应关系
kebab_example: aliyun sae list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type application --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only `application` is supported
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. A single query returns up to 50 results. If the total number of results exceeds 50, a NextToken is returned. You can use this token in the next query to retrieve the remaining results
parameters.help_zh: 一次查询最多返回50条结果，当结果超过50条时，会同时返回一个NextToken，下一次查询使用该NextToken即可查询前50条结果之外的结果
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. You can specify multiple resource IDs separated by commas (,). This parameter is required if you do not specify the Tags parameter
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。可填写多个资源ID，用英文逗号（,）分隔。当您未输入Tags参数时必填
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The tag key-value pairs. This parameter is required if you do not specify the ResourceIds parameter.
key: the tag key. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
value: the tag value. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

Tag keys and values are case-sensitive. If you specify multiple tags, multiple tags are created and bound to the specified resource at the same time. A tag key on a resource can map to only one tag value. If you add a tag with an existing key, the tag value is updated to the new value.

The key and value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
标签键值对，当您未输入ResourceIds参数时必填。取值说明如下：
key：标签键，字符长度范围[1,128]。
value：标签值，字符长度范围[1,128]。

区分大小写。如果指定多个标签，则会为指定资源同时创建并绑定多个标签。同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。

不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tags
